The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

To understand blockchain technology, imagine a shared notebook that everyone in a large community has a copy of. Instead of one person holding the only notebook, every participant has an identical version. If someone wants to write a new entry, they shout it out to the group. Everyone checks their own notebook to make sure the new entry makes sense and hasn't been written before. Once the majority agrees it's valid, everyone writes it down in their own copy at the same time. Because everyone has the same record, it's nearly impossible for anyone to secretly change a past entry without everyone else noticing, making the record very secure and trustworthy.
